shortDescription: Manage SSH proxy security profile rules on a BIG-IP

options.name: action
options.description: Species the action of the rule which is to be applied to the SSH security profile.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the rule that will be applied to the SSH security profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: profile_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SSH security profile to which this rule applies.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the SSH proxy security profile rule is created. When C(absent), ensures the SSH proxy security profile rule is removed.

options.name: users
options.description: Specifies the list of users to be added to the SSH proxy permissions list.
